display.purpose: Page titles and the desktop sidebar brand; the largest type on a screen (26px).

body.purpose: Base reading text and control labels (15px); 14px in Ink 2 for secondary body.

numeral.purpose: Every quantity, price, macro, and date — mono, always tabular figures.

label.purpose: 10px uppercase mono in Ink 3; eyebrows, field labels, section headers, metadata.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default 1px lift on cards, rows, tickets. Barely visible.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Floating overlays only — dropdowns, sheets, palette, confirm dialogs.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for entrances and state transitions (phase chip, bars, overlays).

motion.name: phase-pop
motion.purpose: Core-loop feedback: phase chip pops on planned→cooked→served.

motion.name: overlay-entrance
motion.purpose: Floating surfaces enter with intent instead of snapping in.

motion.name: macro-grow
motion.purpose: Macro bars grow to new values on the GPU (no layout thrash).

motion.name: route-crossfade
motion.purpose: Client route navigations crossfade via the View Transitions API.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> transition/animation none; view-transition durations 0s

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Shared :focus-visible ring on all interactive elements; replaces outline.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Bottom nav becomes 220px left sidebar; content uncaps to 960px; card lists reflow to auto-fill grid.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single teal call-to-action; one per screen.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action; white surface with hairline border.

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface, hairline border, resting shadow; the primary container.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 16px field (no iOS zoom); accent border + focus ring on focus.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Mono pill tag; neutral by default, accent/status variants for state.
components.html: 2 CT $4.20 LOW

components.name: Bottom Nav / Sidebar Item
components.description: Ink-3 at rest, teal when active; row-form in the desktop sidebar.
components.html: Today

components.name: Macro Bar
components.description: Planned fill behind a served fill in the nutrient's chart color; grows via transform:scaleX (no layout thrash).

components.name: Phase Chip
components.description: Encodes meal state: planned (neutral), cooked (warn), served (ok). Springs on state change.

narrative.overview: Platr is a household's food operation rendered as a single calm, dense productivity tool. It plays the category standard straight — a clean, familiar productivity-tool look executed impeccably, no gimmick — and holds itself to Linear's craft bar: crisp neutral surfaces, tight typography, one restrained accent, fast and information-dense. Light-first by intent, built for a returning power user. The world is cool and near-monochrome: a light cool-gray canvas carries white surfaces separated by hairline borders and barely-there 1px shadows; text is near-black; a single teal accent appears sparingly to mark the one live action or current selection. System fonts throughout, with a monospace stack reserved for eyebrows, metadata, and every numeral, always in tabular figures. It refuses the friendly rounded-card + food-photo + soft-green planner look, its Notion-lite opposite, and decorative novelty alike.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first cool-neutral canvas with white surfaces and hairline (1px) borders.
One teal accent (#1E7A8C), used sparingly for the primary action and current selection.
System font stack; tight tracking on headings; monospace + tabular numerals for all figures.
6–12px radii, 1px ambient shadows; information-dense, mobile-first, one-handed.
Responsive shell: bottom nav on mobile, fixed left sidebar at ≥1024px.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only accent and appears on a small fraction of any screen — the primary action and the current selection. If two things are teal on a screen, one of them is probably wrong.

rules.name: The Weak-Line-Ink Triad Rule
rules.body: Every status color ships as a set: a -weak tint background, a -line border, and the saturated hue for text/icon. Never place a saturated status hue as a large fill.

rules.name: The Signal-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Color marks state (planned/cooked/served, low/run-out, pass/fail, selected/active). A surface with no state is neutral. Do not colorize for variety.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Numbers are set in the mono stack with tabular figures — never in the sans body face. Quantities, prices, macros, and dates must align vertically wherever they stack.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Structural labels are 10px uppercase monospace in Ink 3 with wide tracking (~0.14em). This is the house label; do not substitute a sans small-caps. Never use it as a kicker above a page title.

rules.name: Inputs Never Zoom
rules.body: Text inputs are 16px so iOS Safari does not auto-zoom on focus. Do not shrink field text below 16px.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px Line border, not a shadow. Resting shadow is a 1px ambient hint only; anything heavier than Resting is reserved for floating overlays.

dos: Do keep teal rare — the primary action and the current selection only (The One Voice Rule).
Do set every number in the mono stack with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
Do separate surfaces with 1px Line hairlines and Resting shadow; reserve the Popover shadow for floating overlays.
Do use the mono 10px uppercase label (Ink 3, ~0.14em tracking) for field labels, section headers, and metadata — but never as a kicker above a page title.
Do ship status color as the weak-tint background + -line border + saturated-ink triad.
Do keep input text at 16px and controls at a 44px min touch target.
Do use the shared focus ring (0 0 0 3px rgba(30,122,140,.28)) on :focus-visible.
Do honor the responsive split: bottom nav below 1024px, 220px left sidebar and 960px content at and above it.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or use macro chart colors (carbs/fat) anywhere outside the macro charts.
Don't fill large areas with a saturated status hue; the tint carries the surface, the hue carries the label.
Don't add heavy or offset drop shadows, gradients, or receipt-scallop / skeuomorphic novelty — tickets are clean cards.
Don't set numbers in the sans body face or use non-tabular figures in stacked data.
Don't exceed the 600px mobile shell width or drop the 84px bottom-nav clearance.
Don't reference the legacy CSS-variable names (--enamel, --paprika, --paper, --turmeric, --sage, --low-*, --run-*) in new code; they are backward-compat aliases remapped onto the canon tokens.
